preconditions.expression: all(char in {'a', 'b', 'c'} for char in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: output_string == ''.join(['b' if char == 'a' else 'a' if char == 'b' else char for char in input_string])
postconditions.description: Each 'a' is replaced with 'b' and each 'b' is replaced with 'a'. All 'c' characters remain unchanged.
